industry.headline: UK Ofcom tightens online child-safety rules ahead of under-16 social media ban
industry.summary: Ofcom introduced legally-binding duties forcing platforms to detect/remove harmful content, protect minors' accounts by default, and curb algorithmic recommendations to minors ahead of the UK's planned under-16 social media ban. This directly reinforces regulatory momentum in NOMO's UK pilot market, where the CEO is already engaging policy, strengthening the case for schools/parents to adopt NOMO as a compliant, pro-social alternative.

industry.headline: Google, Meta and TikTok sue to block New York's social media mental-health warning law
industry.summary: Major platforms are suing to block New York's law requiring mental-health warning labels on addictive design features (infinite scroll, autoplay) for younger users, set to take effect Jan 2027. This ongoing litigation in NOMO's live US GTM market validates the screen-time-harm narrative underpinning NOMO's pitch to schools and districts seeking third-party alternatives.

industry.headline: Washington AG drops youth social media legislation push after Meta settlement delivers safety features and funding
industry.summary: A multistate settlement with Meta will roll out teen safeguards (time limits, nighttime notification blocks, autoplay opt-outs) and could unlock ~$100M more for state youth mental-health programs if other platforms adopt similar standards. This signals a concrete funding pool in the active US GTM market that NOMO's school/EdTech partnerships could potentially tap.

industry.headline: Meta and TikTok settlements show state AGs using litigation to force durable platform governance changes
industry.summary: Legal analysis of the $17.1B Meta settlement and ongoing TikTok litigation shows state AGs shifting from fines toward mandated product/governance reform. This structural trend could push schools and districts toward independent, compliance-friendly engagement tools like NOMO rather than relying on platform self-reform.

industry.headline: Loyalty industry newswire: big-brand consolidation, fintech rewards expansion, and new seed funding (Squeez, Points4Purpose)
industry.summary: Weekly loyalty roundup covers platform consolidation (Sunoco), reciprocal loyalty deals (Accor/Hard Rock), a charitable-giving loyalty platform expansion (Points4Purpose), and fresh seed funding into experiential rewards startup Squeez. These are useful comparables for NOMO's own partner-prize and experiential reward strategy as it scales.
